**Premise correction:** There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware registered in this repository.

The codebase implements only request size limits (upload size limits and content length limits tracked in instance settings), not API rate limiting based on requests per user. The only middleware implemented in the API layer is authentication and authorization middleware (registered at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69-97`), which checks user identity and access permissions but does not enforce per-user request rate limits. Rate limiting is not implemented as a feature in this system.
